initialPotentialInterpretation: 최초 소울 잠재능력은 무료 레어로 부여된다고 가정합니다.

miracleTime.pityInterpretation: 2025-06-29 공식 이벤트는 큐브 등급 상승 보장 횟수가 사용당 1회 증가한다고 안내합니다. 소울 공지의 보장 횟수와 미라클 적용 안내를 결합해 소울도 보장 횟수를 유지하는 것으로 해석합니다.

requestContract.nLevelMeaning: Soul amplification stage (1-4), not equipment level

normalization.probability: Duplicate labels are combined; displayed percentages are divided by their table sum. The final entry absorbs floating-point residue.
normalization.normalGrade: Derived from Rare second-option mixture, independently cross-checked against the third option. Residuals <= 0.000002 are removed as displayed-percentage rounding noise.
normalization.optionGradeMixtures: Each second- and third-option table is checked against the first-option pools and official grade mixture, with absolute probability tolerance 0.000005.
normalization.rareAndUniqueGradeMixture: 1.9608% and 98.03922% are normalized by their displayed sum 100.00002%.
normalization.duplicateLimits: The Soul probability guide specifies identical-result exclusion and no additional per-option duplicate limit; all options allow three lines.
